title: Strata schemes and Strata Hub
summary: This page provides resources and links for managing strata schemes, including accessing the Strata Hub, searching for schemes, submitting annual reports, and resolving disputes.

internal_links.text: Submit a strata scheme annual report

faqs.q: How can I access the Strata Hub?
faqs.a: You can register or log in to the Strata Hub to manage your strata scheme.

faqs.q: Where can I search for a strata scheme?
faqs.a: You can search online to find a NSW strata scheme using the provided search tool.

faqs.q: How do I submit a strata scheme annual report?
faqs.a: You can submit a strata scheme annual report through the dedicated online service.

faqs.q: What if I need to resolve a strata dispute?
faqs.a: There is a service available to help you resolve a strata dispute.
